summary: The proposed patch addresses the inconsistency in double single-quote management in FITS cards. It replaces all occurrences of double single quotes with single single quotes in both the parsing and serialization processes.

issues.description: The patch may not handle all edge cases related to single-quote management in FITS cards. For example, it does not address cases where single quotes are part of a larger string with special characters or delimiters.
The patch uses a regular expression in one place and the `replace` method in another. This inconsistency could be improved for better readability and maintainability.
